Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH team,

You cite rising market indices, yet your earlier letter says your alloy requirements are covered at fixed prices—it seems the key distinction is when market pressure actually reaches your costs. Please share your cost-breakdown XLSX, building on your offer to review the calculation, so we can establish a durable price basis for our partnership. How do the material and conversion elements support the proposed price while that fixed-price coverage remains in place?

We confirm a binding volume of 94,800 units per year for 24 months. Using your own cost shares (AS-14404 45%, LCI-C 5%, PPI-C2431 38%) and the latest six-month index moves (AS-14404 -0.3% (idx:AS-14404@2026-03, idx:AS-14404@2026-09), LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C2431 +9.7%), your cost increase comes to about +3.6% of the price, not +11.0%. Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.72 per unit, no index clause, 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
That is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We welcome your commitment to a 24-month volume, but we cannot maintain a fixed price for this duration and must implement an AS-14404 index clause.
With the index clause in place to manage material fluctuations, we can offer a revised base price of €5.51 per unit.
Our colleagues will reach out separately to address your questions regarding the price basis and calculation.
Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.51 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.body:
Dear Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH team,

You emphasise that your material costs are covered at fixed prices, yet require index protection—it sounds like your concern is exposure after that cover ends. We can recognise that interest if transferring material risk to us is matched by a lower base price. What in your calculation justifies raising the base price as well as passing through material fluctuations?

We confirm a binding volume of 94,800 units per year for 24 months. Our demand forecast for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09). As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +3.6%.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.92 per unit, AS-14404 index clause (45% share, 0% deadband), 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
